ITEM 1 | Single irregular piece of meat-like food, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, reddish-brown exterior with darker browned edges, sliced into thin strips showing fibrous grain, slightly glossy, sits at lower-left of plate, covers roughly 8% of plate surface, about 1 cm thick | 60

ITEM 2 | Granular crumb-like topping, tan to golden-brown, dry and crumbly with small loose particles scattered over and around the meat piece, covers about 5% of plate surface, under 0.5 cm deep | 15

ITEM 3 | Finely chopped green bits, bright green flecks mixed into the crumb topping and on the meat, dry, scattered sparsely, covers under 1% of plate surface | 2

ITEM 4 | Thin orange-red strip, glossy and slightly moist, about 2 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, sits beside the bottom edge of the meat piece on the plate, covers under 1% of plate surface | 2
